title.en: Metamunity proposal: the city diagnosed as a structure
title.zh: 「元社区」提案：把城市诊断为一种结构

what.en: A proposal coins 元社区 (Metamunity) and says the metaverse 的本质是一种面向未来的叙事 (is in essence a narrative facing the future). It argues that the city's structure 在无形中把一个个人变成了原子化的个体 (invisibly turns persons into atomised individuals), and that 城市中社会联结机制的结构性问题 (the structural problem of the city's social-connection mechanism) is the main factor behind loneliness, the lack of belonging and cold relationships.
what.zh: 一份提案造出「元社区（Metamunity）」一词，并称「元宇宙的本质是一种面向未来的叙事」。它认为城市的结构「在无形中把一个个人变成了原子化的个体」，而「城市中社会联结机制的结构性问题」是让人产生孤独感、缺乏归属感、人际关系淡漠的主要因素。

evidence.quote: 元社区（Metamunity），由前缀“ meta”(意思是超越)和词干“ munity”
它的结构在无形中把一个个人变成了原子化的个体
城市中社会联结机制的结构性问题却是让我们产生孤独感，缺乏归属感

title.en: World of Possibilities: an ontology in which possibility is defined
title.zh: 「World of Possibilities」（《可能性的世界》）：一个定义了可能性的存在论

what.en: A twelve-line book opening defines in sequence, from difference and change, structure, space, time, dynamic, possibility, thing and system: "If change may happen to a structure, it possesses possibility", and a system is "A thing that maintains certain dynamic pattern over time". It admits that not every concept can be well defined without becoming self-referential.
what.zh: 一部书的开篇共十二行，从差异与变化出发，依次定义结构、空间、时间、动态、可能性、事物与系统：「If change may happen to a structure, it possesses possibility」（结构若可能发生变化，便具有可能性）；系统是「A thing that maintains certain dynamic pattern over time」（在时间中维持某种动态模式的事物）。它承认并非每个概念都能被良好定义，否则不免自我指涉。

evidence.quote: If change may happen to a structure, it possesses possibility.
A thing that maintains certain dynamic pattern over time, is a system.
A world of possibility is a world of differences, of changes.

title.en: Moloch as single-value optimisation; any framework must prevent convergence
title.zh: Moloch 定义为单一维度优化；任何框架都须保证不收敛

what.en: A turn in Chinese, asking for its views to be made into a speech, defines the Moloch problem as 单一维度优化（single value optimization，例如资本）的零和博弈 (a zero-sum game of single-value optimisation, for example capital), in which an agent's more complex strategy and competitive advantage make the system converge, a convergence it ties to 因为attractor的存在 (the existence of an attractor). It requires that a new framework 必须可以保证权利结构不收敛 (must guarantee the power structure does not converge).
what.zh: 一段请求整理成演讲的中文观点，把 Moloch 问题定义为「单一维度优化（single value optimization，例如资本）的零和博弈」：一个 agent 产生更复杂的博弈策略并带来竞争优势时，系统便会收敛，并写道「如果这种收敛（因为attractor的存在）不加控制」。它要求新的框架「必须可以保证权利结构不收敛」。

如果这种收敛（因为attractor的存在）不加控制，导致当下社会结构愈加不稳定甚至解体

title.en: Game-design axiom and many games against convergence

title.en: One thread: the selection mechanism
title.zh: 一条线索：选择机制

intro.en: The selection mechanism, followed through the points marked on the thread. In July 2024 a society picks one value as the token of power, and those best at optimising it come to control the social system. In October 2024 an AI-drafted note names a self-reinforcing loop in which "The system naturally selects for pure capital optimizers". In 2025 a meta-attractor that colonizes "even the mechanisms of selection themselves", then defined, in an AI-written expansion, as "a second-order attractor" in joint state and selection-rule space. In May 2026, in a working stance AI-written from a conversation, the system concentrates "not just resources but a way of seeing". In October 2026, on the spine, capture through the rule and then closed capture: in a selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects, "a loss the loop does not read leaves it locked however large it grows"; T7 states "That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured." And in one trained system, T7's frozen test of the conjecture that a judge formed from what it selected is a pool of readers counted by kind: "Every frozen verdict passed, and the conjecture failed for this judge". Only the spine's steps are proved, in a model; each row says what its step claimed.
intro.zh: 选择机制，沿这条线索上标出的各点。2024 年 7 月：一个社会选出一种价值作为权力的象征，最擅长优化它的人逐渐掌控社会系统。2024 年 10 月：一份由 AI 起草的笔记写出一个自我强化的环，其中「The system naturally selects for pure capital optimizers」（系统自然地选出纯粹的资本优化者）。2025 年：一个元吸引子，殖民「even the mechanisms of selection themselves」（甚至选择机制本身），继而在一份由 AI 撰写的展开中，被定义为状态与选择规则联合空间中的「a second-order attractor」（二阶吸引子）。2026 年 5 月：在一份由 AI 据一次对话写成的工作立场中，该系统所集中的是「not just resources but a way of seeing」（不只是资源，还有一种观看方式）。2026 年 10 月，在脊柱上：经由规则的捕获，继而闭合的捕获：在一个其规则以及规则如何被读都从它所选出之份额读出的选择中，「a loss the loop does not read leaves it locked however large it grows」（环所不读的损失，无论增长多大，都让它保持锁定）；T7 写明「That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.」（实际的度量是这样形成的，这是猜想。）最后，在一个训练出的系统中，T7 的冻结检验所检验的猜想是：由它所选出者形成的评判者，是一个按种类计数的读者池；结果是「Every frozen verdict passed, and the conjecture failed for this judge」（每一冻结裁决都通过，而该猜想对这个评判者不成立）。只有脊柱上的步骤是证明了的，并且是在一个模型中；每一行说出它那一步主张了什么。

what.en: From 9 to 30 October 2026 the theory of becoming is named, its Lean spine gets an axiom-free pure core, the ethics' scope and order premises are separated, no central result is found to be new mathematics, the root becomes a grammar of continuation relative to a class, the account is laid out in four layers, and T7's frozen test passes every verdict while its bridge fails.
